recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-14500. No follow-up is needed for the duplicate abatement-age expression in current FHIR core; any broader search-parameter expression syntax audit should be handled under its own issue scope.
issue_request: FHIR-14500 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for STU3 asking to remove the duplicate Condition.abatement.as(Age) term from the Condition abatement-age search parameter expression.
initial_application: Historical commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92 includes GF#14500 in its message and changed source/condition/condition-spreadsheet.xml from Condition.abatement.as(Age) | Condition.abatement.as(Range) | Condition.abatement.as(Age) to Condition.abatement.as(Age) | Condition.abatement.as(Range).
additional_context: The Condition resource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has moved the search parameter to source/condition/bundle-Condition-search-params.xml, where abatement-age is Condition.abatement.ofType(Age) | Condition.abatement.ofType(Range). The frozen tools/history/release3/search-parameters.xml copy still shows the original duplicate, while release4, release4b, and current source do not; that remaining duplicate is historical publication data rather than an active current source defect. FHIR-15679 and FHIR-27532 are related broader/later expression-cleanup issues but were not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current authoritative source already satisfies the requested duplicate removal and editing the STU3 history copy would rewrite frozen historical release evidence.
